# Decision log

## ROI/TLF

- ROI side: not given by the user; treated as bilateral (both hemispheres).
- ROI_Input: head velocity from the vestibular nuclei. ROI_Output: inhibition of the floccular target neurons.

## Hypotheses

- Golgi cells of the flocculus are modelled as a makeshift population (H3) inside scope S1.
- The Golgi-to-granule projection is included as an existence hypothesis from cat data (H5).
